title: Last Delivery
hook: One package. One night. The whole city wants it.

characters.name: Mara
characters.look: a courier in a red hoodie with a messenger bag

beats.say: Mara had one package left, and the whole city wanted it.
beats.see: Night in Rome: the Colosseum lit up, traffic humming through the old streets
Mara runs down a narrow street past the Colosseum, a police car skidding behind her
A countdown timer ticks in the corner of the screen as sirens wail
Mara leaps the gap between two rooftops, the camera shaking as she lands
Gunshots ring out; time slows as she dodges a bullet in slow motion
A guard grabs her bag; she fights him off with a punch

beats.say: A motorbike, a key in it, and a wall of fire behind.
beats.see: Mara jumps on a motorbike as an explosion throws debris across the street

beats.say: Across the river, over the border, into the dawn.
beats.see: A map draws her route across Europe from Rome to Paris
Dawn in a Paris square: Mara hands over the package and walks away
